project_context.vibe: Professional yet fresh, rural modern, approachable, and trustworthy.
project_context.target_audience: BUMDES officers (Director, Treasurer, Unit Managers) in a modern rural setting.

fonts.name: Plus Jakarta Sans
fonts.usage: Body, UI elements, Data tables, Forms

typography.rules: Never use Inter or generic sans for headings. Emphasize tracking-tight on large headings. Apply Plus Jakarta Sans for high legibility in data-heavy views.

colors.rules: Do not use pure black. Use #1A2E1E (Dark Olive) for primary text to ensure contrast over pastel backgrounds. Use Hijau Muda (#D4E09B) and Krem (#FDFBF7) as base, Biru Muda and Ungu Muda for chart accents.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Soft Utility. Flat surfaces, max 8px border-radius (`rounded-lg`). Subtle 1px borders (`border-[#E8EAE6]`). NO heavy drop shadows. Use `shadow-sm` on cards. Do NOT use glassmorphism for health/finance apps; stick to solid.
visual_enhancers.charts: Use pastel palette for charts (Hijau Muda, Biru Muda, Ungu Muda) with Recharts. Ensure chart tooltips have clear dark text.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (Duotone) via `@phosphor-icons/react` for a friendly, professional look.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border on interactive elements. Soft borders on cards to structure the High Density Grid.

components.buttons: Subtle rounded (`rounded-lg`). Primary button: `bg-[#2E4F32] text-white hover:bg-[#1A2E1E]`. Secondary: `bg-[#D4E09B] text-[#2E4F32] hover:bg-[#C2D184]`.
components.cards: Flat white cards (`bg-white border border-[#E8EAE6] rounded-lg p-6`). Minimalist and clean.
components.forms: Shadcn UI forms. Inputs with `bg-[#FDFBF7] border border-[#E8EAE6] focus:border-[#8CA650] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#8CA650]`.
components.tables: Shadcn UI tables. Clean rows, borders on bottom of each row. Headers must have uppercase small labels for scanability.
components.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar. Background `#FFFFFF`, right border 1px `border-[#E8EAE6]`. Active link: `bg-[#D4E09B] text-[#2E4F32] rounded-md`.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_bento: High Density Grid. Base: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3`. Gap: `gap-6`. Every pixel utilized for metrics.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. `p-6` or `p-8` inside cards. `gap-8` between major sections.
grids_and_layouts.mobile_first: Stack everything on mobile. Hide sidebar behind a hamburger menu on mobile (Shadcn Sheet).

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all buttons/links (`transition-colors duration-200`). Staggered list entrances.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over pastel backgrounds uses dark colors (`#2E4F32` or `#1A2E1E`). NEVER use white text on light pastel colors.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all inputs/buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react recharts framer-motion`.
Use standard HTML structure but leverage Tailwind for styling.
Create a layout wrapper with a fixed sidebar (desktop) and bottom nav/hamburger (mobile).
For the main dashboard, build a grid showing 6 business units summary and a main chart area.
Ensure the UI uses the specified pastel palette while maintaining high contrast for text.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`).
Do NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or rounded-lg).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
